annotations.title: Cancel and refund an SMS rental

description: Cancel a long-term SMS rental and refund the full amount to the wallet. Only works for rentals LONGER than 15 days, within 2 hours of purchase, AND only if the number has NOT received any message — this mirrors the provider refund rules, so a 15-day-or-shorter rental, a passed window, or a code that already arrived returns a clear reason and refunds nothing. Use for a genuine change of mind or a wrong purchase shortly after renting. The receiptId comes from rent_sms_number or list_sms_orders. Requires a connected agent wallet.

receiptId.description: The rental receipt ID from rent_sms_number or list_sms_orders

name: cancel_sms_rental
